Name: CP or AT - ENGloomy's Flute Blocks and Pitch Menu
Author: ENGloomy
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=2]✶⋆.˚ Adds [b]24 unique retextures[/b] for flute blocks and drum blocks.
✶⋆.˚ Includes a [b]separate[/b] downloadable file for pitch selection via an in-game menu, simplifying the process of creating flute block music.[/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/tR84PJsc/flute.gif[/img]
[b][size=5]Retexture Pack Installation & Usage:[/size][/b]
[/font][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/][font=Trebuchet MS]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/font][/url]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#ffe599][size=4]For the CP (Content Patcher) Version:[/size][/color][/b][list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[list]
[*]Use the mod options menu to select your preferred textures, which will replace all default textures.
[/list][/list][b][color=#f9cb9c][size=4]For the AT (Alternative Textures) Version:[/size][/color][/b][list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].
[*]Use the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket[/url]﻿ or [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Spray-Can-Tool]Spray Can [/url]﻿to apply textures freely, allowing for [b][color=#ffd966]custom combinations[/color][/b].
[/list]
[b][size=5]Pitch Menu Installation & Usage:[/size][/b][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]
[*]Download the pitch menu mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*][b][color=#ffd966]Right-click[/color][/b] a flute block to open the pitch selection menu.
[list]
[*]Select a pitch by clicking the text button.
[*]Press Esc or E to close the menu without changing the pitch.
[/list][/list][size=2]────────────────────୨ৎ────────────────────
[/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on Windows.[/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]SMAPI 4.2.1[/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Content Patcher 2.6.1[/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Generic Mod Config Menu 1.14.1[/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]Alternative Textures 8.0.0[/font]
